versions.changelog:
- Removed an internal script: scripts/skill_evaluator_v2.py
- No changes to the user-facing documentation or functionality.

Initial release of HarmonyOS 开发技能 covering HarmonyOS app development (5.0–6.1) using ArkTS and Stage model.

- Provides development guidance for ArkTS language and ArkUI declarative UI.
- Covers typical HarmonyOS app workflows, including resource management and distributed capabilities.
- Includes quick navigation to key HarmonyOS official documentation.
- Offers code examples and modular breakdowns for HAP, HAR, and HSP packages.
- Guides on environment setup using DevEco Studio and project structure best practices.
